Select the VARMA order by information criterion

Source: R/lingam_varma.r
select_varma_order.Rd

All candidate orders (p, q) in 0:max_p x 0:max_q (excluding (0, 0)) are compared on a common sample: the stage-1 long VAR is estimated once with h derived from (max_p, max_q), and every stage-2 candidate regression uses the same window t = h + max_q + 1 .. n, so the criteria are comparable across orders (same rationale as select_var_lag()).

Usage

select_varma_order(X, max_p, max_q, criterion = "bic")

Arguments

X

numeric matrix (n_samples x n_features)

max_p

maximum AR order to consider

max_q

maximum MA order to consider

criterion

"bic", "aic", or "hqic"

Value

the selected order c(p, q) (integer vector)
